unlisted_practices: Implement explainable AI (XAI) models that clarify how AI makes decisions.
Obtain community consent for data use in AI systems.
Use robust data privacy practices, including encryption and secure storage, for health data used in AI.
Create mentorship and training programs to build a diverse AI/ML workforce including minority students and researchers.
Design AI systems that are affordable, scalable, and adaptable to the needs of low-resource environments.
Train personnel on optimal language prompts for generative AI to ensure equitable outcomes.
Integrate social determinants of health data into AI models to provide a more holistic view of patient health.
Engage trusted community organizations and leaders to advocate for the ethical use of AI.
Establish clear and enforceable ethical standards for AI through collaboration among policymakers, healthcare institutions, and AI developers.
Engage community representatives to review the design and interpretation of research findings using AI data analysis and tailored care approaches.
